SELECT substr(e.event_date, 1, 4) AS event_year, MIN(e.event_date) AS first_date, MAX(e.event_date) AS last_date, COUNT(*) AS budget_lines, COUNT(DISTINCT b.budget_id) AS distinct_lines, COUNT(b.spent) AS amounts, SUM(b.spent) AS total_spent, MAX(ABS(b.spent - ROUND(b.spent, 2))) AS max_subcent_difference
FROM main.budget AS b
LEFT JOIN main.event AS e ON e.event_id = b.link_to_event
GROUP BY substr(e.event_date, 1, 4)

SELECT
    SUM(b.spent) FILTER (WHERE e.event_date < '2020-01-01')
    - SUM(b.spent) FILTER (WHERE e.event_date >= '2020-01-01') AS spent_2019_minus_2020
FROM main.budget AS b
JOIN main.event AS e ON e.event_id = b.link_to_event
WHERE e.event_date >= '2019-01-01'
  AND e.event_date < '2021-01-01'
LIMIT 1
